purpose: Customer proof repository for reviews, testimonials, before/after work comparisons, studio presentation, verified staff profiles, verified service catalog data, and verified company/about information.

sources.label: I Glow Beauty Bar — Primary Google seed source
sources.notes: Primary authoritative user-provided seed source for review, testimonial, and customer proof collection. Import details only when they can be verified from this source or supplied directly by the business owner.

sources.label: I Glow Beauty Bar — Primary company/about profile
sources.notes: Primary authoritative user-provided source for company identity, About/business overview, location context, booking destination, and business-level profile information. Preserve wording from the source when exact About copy can be verified; do not invent company claims that are not present on Vagaro or supplied directly by the business owner.

sources.label: I Glow Beauty Bar — Primary staff directory
sources.notes: Primary authoritative user-provided source for staff names, professional roles, service associations, and booking/profile links. Do not infer employee identities from photographs; publish staff details only when verified from Vagaro or supplied directly by the business owner.

sources.label: I Glow Beauty Bar — Primary services catalog
sources.notes: Primary authoritative user-provided source for service categories, service names, descriptions, durations, prices, staff associations, and booking links. Keep pricing and availability source-linked because they may change.

sources.label: I Glow Beauty Bar — Secondary Google shared listing
sources.notes: Previously supplied Google source retained as a secondary seed/reference. Review details should only be imported when they can be verified from the source or supplied directly by the business owner.
